responseText:
These caves have become a graveyard for the unprepared. Corrupted Grabber machines stalk the region, twisted remnants of old technology turned feral. The Clay Dwarves are even worse: silent, relentless, and merciless to any who trespass. 

You've seen the wounded. Some were lucky enough to escape. Most weren't.
